---
title: "Theme dark mode kept when the dark brand file is ignored"
format:
  html:
    theme:
      light: flatly
      dark: darkly
brand:
  light: united-brand.yml
  dark: comment-only-dark-brand-with-theme.yml
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'comment-only-dark-brand-with-theme\.yml has no content and will be ignored'
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['link.quarto-color-alternate', 'body.quarto-light']
        - []
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['quarto-color-scheme-toggle']
        - []
---

The theme supplies the dark mode, so the toggle stays even though the dark brand file is ignored.
